_README: Every application this system may automate, keyed by app_id.
app_id names a VENDOR PRODUCT, not a tenant and not a URL — that indirection is what
lets one recorded capability serve many institutions running the same software.
This file starts EMPTY of targets: apps are registered at runtime from the console
(Add app) or via POST /api/targets. Nothing in src/ hardcodes a hostname, a route,
or a credential — point the system at any application you are permitted to automate.
Credentials are referenced BY ENV VAR NAME (derived at registration). Secret values
live in gitignored data/creds/<app_id>.json, never in this file, an artifact, a
Keys beginning with an underscore are ignored by the loader.
